2440-3263-4347-7850.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Griffins.
2440-3263-4347-7850.description:
Cast Misthollow Griffin by paying {4}.
When Misthollow Griffin enters, Mirror of Life Trapping and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Griffin you control.
Resolve the Mirror of Life Trapping trigger, exiling Misthollow Griffin.
Repeat.

569-2226-2499.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
569-2226-2499.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mist Raven by paying its mana cost.
When Mist Raven enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

907-2645-2872-3430.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2645-2872-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-1832-2034-3845.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-3845.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

997-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
997-5254-6627.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-6972-7936.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1753-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1778-3558-6516-7735.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3558-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1879-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2308-6705-7492.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power or toughness 1 or less.
2034-2308-6705-7492.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature with power or toughness 1 or less, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Arnyn triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Beast creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
Repeat.
2034-2308-6705-7492.notes: You can instead sacrifice the Beast to Ashnod's Altar to gain mana, and then sacrifice the Frog to Quina to place counters.

147-2511-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-4842-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

4053-5147-7134--145.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1636-4023-4779-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-4023-4779-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2811-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
2811-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 using the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

339-677-3967-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1409-3875-6763-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token. Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
1409-3875-6763-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

1563-2457-4094-4927.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-2457-4094-4927.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

813-4598-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-4598-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1657-4381.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat from step 2.

851-5636-5742-5743.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-2781-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1308-2781-5917.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Felidar Guardian that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

1461-1545-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-1545-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Wurmcoil Engine's toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Trostani triggers twice, causing you to gain life equal to the Wurms' combined toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1527-2488-2968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls at least one creature.
1527-2488-2968.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W}, giving Apex Altisaur and any creature an opponent controls +1/+1 and indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing Apex Altisaur to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Apex Altisaur's second ability triggers, and Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers if the opposing creature's toughness is less than 0.
Resolve the Magmatic Galleon trigger, if applicable, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.

2862-3120-3923-4050.notablePrerequisites: Mindsplice Apparatus has at least two oil counters on it.
2862-3120-3923-4050.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {U}.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a 3/3 Wraith creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wraith, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2047-2882.notablePrerequisites:
Mechanized Production attached to an artifact creature you control.
You control at least seven nontoken creatures.
2047-2882.description:
Cast Infinite Reflection by paying {5}{U}, attaching it to the creature that has Mechanized Production attached.
Each other nontoken creature you control becomes a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

618-1692.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Kiki-Jiki.
618-1692.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a non-legendary copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the untapped non-legendary Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2.

776-1329-2709-3682.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-3682.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Mox Amber to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Mox Amber.
Cast Mox Amber.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1409-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1409-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Palinchron.
Repeat.
1409-3542.notes: If up to seven lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1987-2510-4125-5116.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-4125-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
